user.title: Connect to STB-Proxy
user.description: Enter the host address and API key for your STB-Proxy instance. The API token can be found or generated in STB-Proxy Settings.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to STB-Proxy server. Check the host address, port, and network.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Please verify the API token configured in STB-Proxy Settings.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with STB-Proxy.

abort.already_configured: This STB-Proxy server is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: STB-Proxy Options
init.description: Configure settings for this STB-Proxy instance.

sync.name: Sync Media Servers
sync.description: Triggers immediate synchronization with configured Plex and Jellyfin media servers in STB-Proxy.

set_block.name: Set Channel Block
set_block.description: Enables or disables a specific channel block in STB-Proxy.

block_name.name: Block Name
block_name.description: The name of the channel block to toggle (case-insensitive).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the channel block should be enabled or disabled.
